# Things 3

Things 3 matches the visuals of the Things 3 application across light and dark modes, using its exact color palettes together with mobile and desktop animations. The recorded description lists a Things-style sidebar, quick switcher, menus and checkboxes, hidden tags, a mobile toolbar, prettified code blocks, full-size video previews and Style Settings support.

![Things 3 screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrparalloid/obsidian-things/HEAD/things-screenshot.jpg)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Things 3"
    author: "mrparalloid"
    repo:   "mrparalloid/obsidian-things"

    github_url:     "https://github.com/mrparalloid/obsidian-things"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrparalloid/obsidian-things/HEAD/things-screenshot.jpg"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Match Things 3 visuals across light and dark modes with exact color palettes and mobile/desktop animations. Bring Things-style sidebar, quick switcher, menus, checkboxes, hidden tags, mobile toolbar, prettified code blocks, full-size YouTube previews, and Style Settings support."
}
```
